description: This file provides utility functions for splitting a string into tokens based on spaces, and storing them in a linked list. It includes functions to split a string, add valid tokens to a list, and validate tokens.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: An object containing utility functions for string splitting and token validation.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the input string into tokens separated by spaces and returns a linked list of tokens.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds the token to the linked list if it passes validation.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if the token is non-empty.
